title: M2: Deep Email Discovery & 7-Role Categorization (R2)
intent: Implement deep public email scraping across subpages, footers, mailto links, asset noise filtering, 7-role categorization, and UI role badges per Requirement R2.
summary: Enhanced contactDiscoveryAgent with concurrent multi-path scraping (/contact, /about, /team, /privacy, /imprint via Promise.allSettled), mailto link query stripping, ReDoS-safe document truncation (100k chars), false-positive noise filtering (.png, .jpg, .css, .js, placeholder domains), and 7-role categorization (security, admin, sales, support, legal, executive, general). Updated ContactRole in osint.ts and added badge styles in DomainIntelligenceView. Added 20 unit tests with 100% pass (219/219 total).
